content:
After joining the Fire Breathers and realizing they were all wiped out, the only clue left is to follow Hank Madigan's trail, who disappeared among the raiders of Pleasant Valley, trying to set up an uplink.

Hack the terminal at Abbie's bunker and head in, completing the quest and starting the Free States portion of the main quest line with their first quest, Early Warnings.

Quest stages[]

Quest stages

Stage

Status

Description

Log Entry

?

Follow Madigan's Trail

I need to find out what happened to Madigan, as his mission was critical to dealing with the Scorched. I should check out his last known location: The Top of the World.

?

Complete Rose's Quests to gain Her Trust

Madigan is dead, but a raider robot named Rose knows where the Scorched Detector Uplink he was trying to set up is located. She won't tell me anymore until I gain her trust by completing a series of tasks for her.

?

Retrieve the Uplink

?

Go to the Free States Bunker

The uplink is damaged. I need to take it to the Free States Bunker. They made it, so hopefully I can find out how to fix it there.
